diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 2.7 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: The board has no regulator and its only active chip is U1 'Tiny85-20-SMT' (ATtiny85-20, non-V grade, per the SparkFun schematic), whose datasheet gives '2.7 - 5.5V for ATtiny25/45/85', so 2.7 V is the true minimum; the 3.3 V figure is only the Qwiic bus nominal (the second reading's '3.3V - 5V' text belongs to the older analog soil sensor section of the hookup guide).
